name: maxy-print-bridge
description: Bridge local WebSocket → impresora térmica ESC/POS (sin diálogo del navegador)

scripts.pkg:win: npm run build && pkg dist/index.js --targets node18-win-x64 --output release/maxy-print-bridge-win-unsigned.exe && node scripts/publish-win-exe.mjs
scripts.pkg:mac-x64: npm run build && pkg dist/index.js --targets node18-macos-x64 --output release/maxy-print-bridge-mac-x64
scripts.pkg:mac-arm64: npm run build && pkg dist/index.js --targets node18-macos-arm64 --output release/maxy-print-bridge-mac-arm64
scripts.pkg:linux-x64: npm run build && pkg dist/index.js --targets node18-linux-x64 --output release/maxy-print-bridge-linux-x64
